_readme: US-2846 AC2. One labelled cell of comp reads, carrying a bundle listing the
WHAT THIS IS, AND WHAT IT IS NOT. Hand-authored samples, not reads taken
from live eBay listings, because the calibration spike (US-2842) that would
give us real ones cannot run without production credentials. It proves the
fit, the trim and the publish gate behave as specified. It does NOT prove
that real apparel cells have a price-vs-grade slope at all - that is the
question the gate exists to answer, cell by cell, once real reads land.
THE BUNDLE IS THE POINT. B01 is a 'lot of 5' listing: it matches the
keywords, reads at high confidence because a flat lay of five fleeces is
perfectly legible, and carries one asking price for five garments. Left in,
it drags the top of the range up hard enough to invent a slope. It is
labelled so a reader can see exactly which row the trim is for.
